subject: King's jewel collection
text: Speaking to the Chef in the castle kitchen and then the King on the top floor allows access to the King's jewel collection past the guard.

evidence.quote:
Enter the castle and speak to the Chef in the kitchen. Afterwards go to the top
floor and speak to the King. Exit the castle and head east of it's entrance.
Follow the path and you'll get to the King's jewel collection. Speak to the
guard and he'll let you pass.

subject: King's jewel collection
text: The King's jewel collection in Herat contains fourteen chests.

evidence.quote:
Now all that's left to do is open the fourteen
chests.

subject: Alumina

evidence.quote:
Now

subject: Falcon
text: Boarding the Falcon at Marse, sailing north to Elba Island, and heading west leads to Aisen Tower.

evidence.quote:
After it warp to Marse and
board the Falcon. Sail north until you reach Elba Island, and then head west to
reach Aisen Tower.

subject: chest
text: A chest in Aisen Tower contains a sour cider.

evidence.quote: Open the chest for a sour cider.

subject: chest
text: Entering the first door leads to a chest with 750 gold pieces.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door, open the chest for 750 gold
pieces, and enter the next door.

subject: chest
text: Entering the second door leads to a chest containing a hi potion.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest for a hi potion, read the note
on the wall, and then enter the door west of it.

subject: chest
text: Going upstairs and through the west door reveals a chest with a power gourd.

evidence.quote:
Go upstairs, enter the west 
door, and open the chest there for a power gourd.

subject: chest
text: Entering the two doors east of Raile reveals chests containing a speed potion and a hi bomb.

evidence.quote:
After 
it enter the two doors east of him to find chests containing a speed potion 
and a hi bomb.

subject: chest
text: Following the south path leads to a chest containing a revive.

evidence.quote: Follow the south path and open the chest there for a revive.

subject: chest
text: Falling through the dead-end pitfall to the east drops the party near a chest with an ex potion.

evidence.quote:
Then walk to the dead end to the east and you'll fall through the floor. Open 
the chest for an ex potion and then walk around till you fall through the 
floor again.

subject: chest
text: Entering the east door on the second floor leads to a room where the eastern door has a chest with an ex potion.

evidence.quote:
Head back up to the second floor and enter the east door this time to find three more doors. Enter the east one first and open the chest for 
an ex potion.

subject: chest
text: Entering the west door on the second floor leads to a chest with a big arrow.

evidence.quote:
Enter the west door next and open the chest there for a big 
arrow.

subject: chest
text: Walking north past the middle door stairs leads to chests containing a swing wing and a smoke ball.

evidence.quote: Walk north and open the chests for a swing wing and a smoke ball.

subject: five switches
text: To solve the five-switch puzzle and open the red door, step on the northwest switch, then southeast, southwest, northeast, and finally northern most switch.

evidence.quote:
Walk west and you'll see a red door and five switches activated by stepping on 
them. Step on the northwest switch first, then the southeast one, followed by 
the southwest one, then the northeast one, and finally step on the northern 
most switch.

subject: pirates
text: Against the pirates, have Hero and Aguro use constant physical attacks while Lufia casts Blast and Jerin casts Blizzard or Boost.

evidence.quote:
For the battle against 
them have Hero and Aguro use constant physical attacks. Lufia should cast 
Blast and Jerin should cast Blizzard, or if you need to heal simply have Jerin 
cast Boost instead.

subject: pirates
text: Defeating the pirates unlocks access to two chests containing the pirate key and a silver tarot.

evidence.quote:
After defeating the pirates and the subsequent dialogue, 
open the two chests for the pirate key and a silver tarot.

subject: chest
text: Unlocking the cell door next to Raile reveals a chest containing a heavy ring.

evidence.quote:
Return to Raile and 
unlock the door to the cell next to him and open the chest for a heavy ring.

subject: Shai Lab 3
text: Speaking to the girl on the west side of Shai Lab 3 bottom floor allows the party to rest for free.

evidence.quote:

rest for free.

Island. Ignore all the eddies and enter the town of Soshette at the northern
most section of the island.
